_note: Draft English rendering of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Shemot 11, generated by scripts/translate_tafsir_english.py against the JA (not the biblical Hebrew). Translation goal: reverse-translatability for the Tafsir reader — readers should be able to map English back to JA. Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: And God said to Moses: 'One affliction yet remains, which I shall bring upon Pharaoh and upon the Egyptians; after that he shall release you from here — and at his releasing, he shall altogether drive you out from here.'
translations.2: 'Command the people, that each man ask as a gift from his neighbor, and each woman from her neighbor, vessels of silver and vessels of gold.'
translations.3: And God granted the people favor in the eyes of the Egyptians. And as for Moses the messenger — he was very great in the land of Egypt, in the eyes of Pharaoh's officers and in the eyes of the people.
translations.4: And Moses said: 'Thus says God: At about the middle of the night I shall appear in the land of Egypt,
translations.5: and every firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die — from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sits upon his throne, to the firstborn of the maidservant who is behind the millstone, and all the firstborn of the beasts.
translations.6: And there shall be a great outcry throughout all the land of Egypt, the like of which has never been, and the like of which shall not occur again.'
translations.7: 'But against all the sons of Israel, no dog shall bark with its mouth — of anything above it in harm — from their people to their beasts; so that you may know what God distinguishes between the Egyptians and the sons of Israel.'
translations.8: 'Then all these servants of yours shall come to me and bow down to me, saying: Go out — you and all the people who are with you; and after that I shall go out.' Then he went out from Pharaoh's presence in great intensity of anger at him.
translations.9: Then God said to Moses: 'Pharaoh will not accept from the two of you, so that My proofs may be multiplied in the land of Egypt.'
translations.10: And Moses and Aaron performed all these proofs in Pharaoh's presence; and God hardened his heart, and he did not release the sons of Israel from his land.
